leads.observation: CheckIn stores UTC HH:mm without date, CheckOut reconstructs using now.Date (UTC). Same Cairo date can span UTC midnight: check-in2026-10-17T21:30Z and checkout2026-10-18T03:30Z are same Cairo business date during UTC+03. Reconstructed Oct18 21:30 is future, worked minutes clamped0 instead of6hours.
leads.impact: WorkHours/overtime understated for night shift, no actual record read or SQL test.
leads.precondition: Both events within same Cairo business date, straddling UTC midnight; check-in not overwritten before checkout.
leads.next: Independent date/arithmetic challenge with actual zone; isolated synthetic component check, not claim full endpoint reproduction.
